summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Gamer LEARN tab. All 11 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end (piano C-major full pass, guitar Open Strings full pass, wrong-key toast + streak reset, hear-note, mic toggle, exit, best-score star, creator regression, no console errors). Feature is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: registerHit uses stale score/streak inside setDone total calc (const total = score + 100 + streak*10) — technically correct here because at that render score/streak reflect state before this hit, but the same math is duplicated with setScore/setStreak (functional updater). Not a bug in practice but brittle; safer to derive total from prior score/streak via functional updater or compute total after next render.

Minor: engineRef is initialized via `if (!engineRef.current) engineRef.current = new MicPitchEngine()` during render — side-effect in render body; move into useEffect or useRef(() => new MicPitchEngine()). Works today but not React-strict friendly.
Minor: LearnPage reads localStorage inline in render on every re-render — fine for a small list but could be lifted into state at mount for cleanliness.
test_credentials: None required — Learn feature is fully client-side
seed_data_creation: Set localStorage pp_learn_best_c-major=1080 to verify best-score ★ badge rendering
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: nav-learn appears in Gamer lane only; instrument picker + 3 lessons each for guitar/piano; practice view exposes all 11 required testids; C Major full 8-note tap sequence [60,62,64,65,67,69,71,72] advances target correctly and completes with score 1080 + Replay/More Lessons buttons; Replay resets score to 0 & target back to C4; wrong-key (D4 while target C4) shows sonner toast 'That was D4 — aim for C4', keeps target on C4, resets streak to 0x; Hear Note fires without error; Start Mic actually succeeded in headless (chromium autogrants) — showed 'Mic live — play the glowing note!' toast, no crash; tap-to-play still works after mic on; learn-exit returns to LearnPage; best score ★1080 shown on c-major card; Guitar Open Strings full 6-cell sequence (5-0..0-0) completes with score 1080; Creator lane Discover with Pp emblem/mosaic loads clean; 0 console errors. NOTE for main agent: 'Made with Emergent' badge sometimes overlaps bottom-nav Learn button in mobile viewport — testing worked around it with JS clicks; consider z-index adjustment.
